records.text: Sun Myung Moon used the Unification Church and affiliated organizations such as CAUSA to support the Contras and promote the Reagan administration’s Central America policy.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #4 (Ep wcD2khO3rOA)

appearances.snippet: He used his logistics network through the churches to aid the Contras through his unification church and their connected organizations like CAUSA... And he also ran PR for the Reagan administration regarding U.S.'s involvement in Central America through his newspaper, The Washington Times.

verification.notes: Contemporary reporting supports CAUSA/Unification movement aid to the Contras and the movement’s organized support for Reagan-era conservative politics. The broader characterization of a single logistics network operating through churches is interpretive and not fully established by the cited evidence.

sources.title: The Unification Church’s Political Influence — TIME
sources.relevance: Documents the Moon organization’s longstanding conservative political activity and support for Ronald Reagan.

sources.title: Moon Group Offers Aid to Contras — Los Angeles Times
sources.relevance: Contemporary report on CAUSA-linked assistance to the Contras.

conveyance.original_source: Email tip read by Candace Owens

records.text: Sun Myung Moon’s network provided roughly $20–40 million that rescued Liberty University in the mid-1990s.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #4 (Ep wcD2khO3rOA)

appearances.snippet: Later would bail Liberty University out. The person in the email said roughly the amount was 20 to 40 million dollars in the mid 1990s.

verification.notes: Contemporary investigations identify a $3.5 million grant and a $400,000 loan—about $3.9 million—not $20–40 million. No credible source supporting the much larger amount was located.

sources.title: A Church in Flux Is Flush With Cash — Washington Post
sources.relevance: Contemporary investigation identifies a $3.5 million grant and $400,000 loan in the Liberty bailout.

sources.relevance: Contemporary account of the Moon-linked Liberty University financing.
